verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's official CLI documents a `scrapingbee schedule` command for cron-based recurring jobs, which is a first-party way to set up background automations. The evidence is a single thin mention, and the feature is described as a gated advanced feature. It is unclear whether jobs run server-side or depend on the user's machine, and there is no detail on monitoring, failure handling or agent-driven triggers. Missing for 10: in-depth schedule documentation, clarity on hosted vs. local execution, job monitoring and alerting, ungated availability, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
